# AWS Elemental MediaConnect

Store flows, sources, outputs, entitlements and VPC interfaces with durable local lifecycle transitions; no media is transported.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `mediaconnect` |
| Signing name | `mediaconnect` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-11-14` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only; deterministic local flow lifecycle worker |
| Selected operations | 22 of 82 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-elemental-mediaconnect) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no media transport, sockets, ingest/egress IPs, EC2 network-interface allocation, health monitoring, actual failover or encryption/key retrieval; lifecycle ACTIVE does not indicate media delivery.
- Media streams, source metadata/thumbnails, maintenance, monitoring configuration, flow sizing, NDI, CDI, JPEG XS, router integration, bridges, gateways, offerings and reservations are unsupported and not whitelisted.
- VPC interface tags are unsupported, including the CloudFormation Tags property.
- SPEKE configuration is stored for entitlement encryption without contacting the key server; IAM trust and permission policies are not evaluated.
- Cross-account entitlement changes do not asynchronously modify existing receiver flow status; references are rechecked on source changes and StartFlow.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
